motion_primitive_groups.coverage: Old data remains the committed endpoint during the action; targeted changed cells are marked, then the complete new state commits.
Cursor and running/done state change without changing observed interval geometry.
Staging source remains while the retained destination is marked Incoming; committed destination preserves policy, inclusion record, and owner.
Capture positions remain visible until the move commits to staging; collection reservations persist.
Committed prior register and incoming result remain distinct until action completion.

motion_primitive_groups.group: Conserved balance geometry and ledger commit
motion_primitive_groups.coverage: Root backing stays fixed while child pending liability settles; balance bars and child ledger commit together.

resolved_findings.resolution: Short segments use positioned T labels and a complete readable legend without altering interval or balance geometry. Rechecked trace and budget in every state/profile.
Retained pool body/policy/owner remain unobscured at the copy endpoint; Incoming coverage during the action preserves the staging source. Rechecked tail-sampling state and motion in every profile.
Matrix and sequence coordinate labels occupy layout space above resident values. Rechecked collection, async lag, OCC, and child budget in every state/profile.

Ordinary causal weights produce the contaminated output; cross-example logits become −∞ before a new normalization, and isolated output remains beside the ordinary output. Explicit numerical contribution and all original values remain legible.

limitations: This report covers the listed clean Volume III build and exact hashes only; later source/runtime/build changes require freshness review.

Every endpoint/profile is visually inspected. Motion samples cover one representative nontrivial action per lesson/profile, explicitly grouped by repeated primitive; they do not constitute frame-by-frame inspection of every transition.
Some long state words and identifiers wrap on narrow screens; characters remain visible and cell labels remain distinct from values.
PNG files are local inspection artifacts bound here by basename and SHA256; not all raster files are stored in the repository.
Timing values in motion records measure browser capture timing and UI animation progress, not modeled system latency.
No real students were recruited; no learning gain or user-study result is claimed.
acceptance_note: Review evidence only. No compiler acceptance overlay was created or applied, and no commit was made.
